title: 💬 Geek Hub
description: A social platform for geeks and introverts to find friends through hobbies — not romance. Join groups, chat in real time, and meet people who love what you love. Like Tinder, but for D&D parties.

title: ⚡ Blaze Shift
description: A fast-paced mobile game set in a neon galaxy. Switch colors mid-flight to survive deadly barriers while dodging at hyperspeed. Built for tilt controls and cosmic chaos.

title: 🛰️ braisgf.dev
description: My official web HQ — part portfolio, part secret lab. Hosted on a Raspberry Pi, styled like a retro console, and hiding a few easter eggs. Welcome to my brain.

title: 📦 Video Transcoder (AWS)
description: A backend tool that accepts video uploads, transcodes them via AWS Elastic Transcoder, and stores the results in S3. Built to automate and scale flawlessly.

title: 🎲 Dice Duel
description: A tabletop-inspired digital game where dice hold magical powers. Use combos, cast spells, and outroll your enemies. Available locally and online.

title: 🧠 RPi5 Dev Server
description: A custom server built with a Raspberry Pi 5 that runs my dev environment, local hosting, and automations. Quiet, cheap, and full of power.

title: 🚁 ROC – Racing Oriented Copter
description: My personal FPV racing drone, built from scratch. Fast, twitchy, and ready to fly through any challenge. Includes FPV feed and onboard action cam.

title: 🤖 Robuyutsu (Mobile Game)
description: A competitive robot-fighting mobile game where you customize your mech, learn combos, and fight in underground circuits. Inspired by Beyblade, Street Fighter, and dreams of glory.

title: ⚙️ Combat Robot Mk.I
description: A physical 1-pound battle robot designed to fight in real-life arenas. Equipped with weapons, armor, and attitude. First prototype already terrifying the cat.

title: 🕵️ Sarcasm Detector 9000
description: An experimental AI that scans phrases and detects sarcasm using transformers, NLP and a built-in Spanish sense of humor. Great for Twitter arguments and passive-aggressive Slack messages.
